newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo firms fire 176,142 workers in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo firms fire 176,142 workers in 1996.

text.p: Private firms located in Sao Paulo state laid off 176,142 employees during 1996 compared with 179,874 workers fired during 1995, said a spokesman for the Sao Paulo State Industries Federation (Fiesp).
The firings during the year total 8.17 percent of the Sao Paulo industrial workforce, compared with 7.68 percent in 1995, the spokesman said.
In December, Sao Paulo firms dismissed 8,586 workers against 7,407 firings during November, Fiesp reported.
Last month, seven sectors hired new personnel, while 36 out of the total 46 sectors included in the survey sacked personnel. Three sectors kept their staffing unchanged, the spokesman said.
